basis: Use the existing 50 ms IMU continuity bound as an explicit ceiling on terminal measurement reuse; this is a modeling policy to evaluate, not a claim of source equivalence or measured accuracy.
requirements: Real samples must cover recovered leading states through their first supported anchor.

Sample gaps intersecting the real supported graph interval cannot exceed the existing continuity bound.
Trailing measurement hold must be reported separately and must never certify full real-sample bracketing.
